title: AI Task Manager — AI-Powered Task Management Platform
shortDescription: Production-ready task management platform with Gemini LLM, LangChain.js, LangGraph multi-agent workflows, and ChromaDB RAG over uploaded PDFs.
fullDescription: Built a production-ready task management platform with the Google Gemini LLM and LangChain.js, enabling AI-driven task prioritization, workload summarization, and productivity recommendations through multi-agent LangGraph workflows. Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with ChromaDB vector storage and semantic search, processing uploaded PDFs into embeddings for context-aware natural language querying across tasks and documents. Engineered secure RESTful APIs with JWT authentication and role-based authorization; designed a normalized MySQL schema for users, tasks, conversations, and AI interaction history, following MVC architecture and modular service layers.
metrics: Automated task prioritization & workload summarization via multi-agent workflows
RAG semantic search across uploaded PDF documents with vector embeddings
Normalized MySQL relational schema with MVC modular service layers

title: Full-Stack Grocery E-Commerce App
shortDescription: High-throughput grocery commerce platform with 500+ products, cart, order workflows, JWT auth, RBAC, and Context API state optimization cutting re-renders by ~25%.
fullDescription: Feature-rich platform with product listings, cart, and order workflows for 500+ products; JWT auth, RBAC, and Admin Dashboard. Optimised frontend state with Context API — reduced unnecessary re-renders, improving performance by ~25%. Modular backend architecture supports real-time cart synchronization, category filtering, and order tracking.
metrics: Managed catalog of 500+ products with instant category filtering
~25% reduction in frontend re-renders via optimized Context API state
Role-based access control with administrative catalog and order management

title: Clueless Closet — AI Fashion Platform
shortDescription: Full-stack wardrobe management app with outfit builder, mix-and-match engine, and AI-driven outfit scheduling for personalized wardrobe recommendations.
fullDescription: Built a full-stack wardrobe management app with an outfit builder, JWT authentication, and image upload; integrated a mix-and-match engine and AI-driven outfit scheduling that supports personalised wardrobe recommendations. Designed with high-fidelity Figma specifications and responsive UI components.
metrics: Dynamic mix-and-match visual outfit canvas with image upload pipeline
AI-driven outfit scheduling based on calendar, weather, and occasion
Secure user profile and wardrobe isolation with JWT authentication

title: Quick.ai — AI SaaS Article Platform (Internship Project)
shortDescription: Full-stack AI SaaS article platform developed at V-Net Technology, using async Node.js/Express to cut API latency by ~20%, with Clerk auth and CI/CD.
fullDescription: Built Quick.ai, a full-stack AI SaaS article platform, using async Node.js and Express.js to support concurrent multi-user sessions, cutting API latency by ~20%. Integrated Clerk authentication with role-based access control (RBAC) and deployed the app on Vercel with a CI/CD pipeline and production environment configuration.
metrics: ~20% API latency cut through async stream optimization in Node.js
Concurrent multi-user session management with enterprise RBAC
Automated CI/CD deployment pipeline to Vercel production

title: Library Management System (Internship Project)
shortDescription: Modular backend system with JWT auth, reusable React components, analytics dashboard, and book management APIs for 100+ records with recommendations.
fullDescription: Built a Library Management System with a modular backend, JWT authentication, reusable React.js components, and an analytics dashboard; developed book management APIs for 100+ records, including issue tracking, wishlist, and recommendations.
metrics: 100+ book inventory records with issue tracking and wishlists
Real-time analytics dashboard on library circulation and usage
Modular RESTful micro-endpoints with JWT route protection
